changelog:
Contract Risk Review v1.0.0

- Initial release of Contract Risk Review skill.
- Supports automated extraction and risk annotation for six contract types (purchase, sales, service, labor, lease, NDA).
- Dual PDF extraction engines (PyMuPDF + pdfplumber) for robust text parsing.
- AI-driven clause extraction and structured risk report generation (summary, key terms table, three-tier risk list).
- Integrated Feishu (Lark) notification for sending interactive risk reports.
- User provides OpenAI-compatible API key for model access; supports multiple AI providers.
- Built-in risk library with configurable checklist and FAQ.
- Free and paid plans with tiered features and batch processing in Pro/Max.
